A bar in Gudhjem with drinks and sea views

NOW OPEN · CHRISTMAS TENT

The Christmas tent is up by the harbour

We're open every day from 12 noon to 10 pm until 20 December. Come in from the cold for a Christmas platter, mulled wine and a view of the waves by the pier. Feel free to book a table.

CHRISTMAS AT JYLKAT

Christmas at Jylkat

Christmas platter 27 November – 20 December

Every day, 12–10 pm, we serve a Christmas platter for 375 DKK per cover: Ruth's spiced herring from Christiansø with red onion, lobster salad with lobster tails in a creamy dressing with dill and green asparagus, smoked salmon with chives, lemon and crisp radishes, roast beef with pickled cucumber and homemade remoulade, Christmas sausage with raw pickled red cabbage, orange and walnuts, our Jyledog with confit duck, pickled red onion, mustard mayo and toasted sesame, plus sourdough bread, rye bread and whipped butter.

Christmas lunch party

Planning a Christmas lunch with colleagues, family or friends? You'll get your own table – we're open every day until 20 December. Want the whole place to yourselves for a bigger event? Get in touch and we'll work something out.

Christmas music quiz Saturday 5 December at 5 pm

During Christmas in Gudhjem, we're holding a Christmas music quiz at Jylkat. It's free to join, and there are great prizes.

ABOUT JYLKAT · GUDHJEM

A bar with Bornholm in the glass.

Jylkat means hedgehog in the Bornholm dialect. Here, locals and visitors meet over cocktails, wine, Bornholm beers and small plates with a view over Gudhjem Harbour. The mood is relaxed, and you're just as welcome for a single drink as for lunch or dinner by the sea.

In summer Jylkat is a summer bar where you sit under the parasols in the sun. The rest of the year we put the tent up when the weather calls for it – so you sit warm and snug, yet still feel you're out in nature, watching the waves crash against the pier and the rocks.
